From the owner
Back Deck Rebuild – Mount Gilead, NC This deck needed more than just new boards—it needed a better design. The original all-wood deck had taken years of direct afternoon and evening sun, causing the wood to dry out, warp, and deteriorate. Instead of rebuilding it the same way, I’m The Guy Construction redesigned the deck with durability, lower maintenance, and better access in mind. We rebuilt the deck using aluminum support posts and an aluminum structural beam, with pressure-treated lumber used for the joist framing. The finished deck features composite decking, white PVC fascia and stair risers, and white aluminum railing and posts. We also relocated the entire staircase to the opposite side of the deck. The original stairs came down to a landing and split in two directions on a side of the house that saw very little use. The new staircase now comes down on the side where a walkway will provide a much more direct route between the deck and the home's carport. The long staircase was finished with composite treads, PVC risers, and aluminum railing, tying the entire project together. This was more than a deck replacement—it was an opportunity to build a more durable, lower-maintenance deck with a layout that better fits the homeowners' everyday needs. I’m The Guy Construction specializes in deck building, deck replacement, composite decking, porches, railings, and exterior renovations throughout Mount Gilead, Albemarle, Charlotte, Norwood, and surrounding areas.

"We can't live without our only bathroom for weeks, and we don't want a dust-covered house." It's one of the most common reasons homeowners put a remodel off, and it's a fair concern. Here's how we deal with it. Before any work starts, your free estimate is based on an in-person walkthrough, so we talk through the scope, the schedule and how we'll protect the rest of your home. You'll know what to expect before you commit to anything. The jobsite gets cleaned every evening, and you hear from us directly when plans or timing change. The work itself is built to last. Custom tile showers get proper Schluter waterproofing, and everything is backed by a 2-year craftsmanship warranty. Our team includes a licensed electrician, and we're bonded and insured.
